summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by Perspective Therapeutics, Inc. reporting the posting of a corporate presentation containing preliminary estimated financials and clinical program updates. No special situation transaction or corporate event is described; the filing merely fulfills disclosure obligations under Items 2.02 and 8.01 for an analyst event presentation. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is present. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
